repository.name: agid-postal-ir
repository.purpose: Iran postal-context contract seed for an independent country-data repository linked to AGID

postal_system.current_code_name: Iran ten-digit postcode and place identifier
postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU Iran addressing sheet updated 10/2023 documents ten digits below the locality and labels zone, segment, part, district, forwarding-code and identification-code components. It also states that P.O. Box and poste restante addresses do not use the postcode. Production assignment requires an exact current Iran Post artifact with postal object type, authority, jurisdiction, validity, retrieval time, schema and digest pinned. A UPU example, GNAF query, certificate page, prefix, coordinate, model or third-party map does not create an assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: A complete ten-digit identifier may refer to a fine-grained delivery location or address object and is not a guaranteed area. Never generate official postal geometry from digits, the five-digit forwarding prefix, a GNAF result, point, administrative containment, proximity, Voronoi or interpolation. Official geometry requires an exact Iran Post artifact explicitly relating the code to a point, polygon or multipolygon and pinning authority, object type, jurisdiction, validity, CRS, topology, licence and digest. Derived surfaces stay independently labelled.
postal_system.address_rule: Recipient, organisation, building name, premise or door, floor, unit, street, sub-street or alley, locality or township or village, sub-locality, province, P.O. Box, post office, poste restante, postcode and coordinates remain typed, sourced, purpose-limited, jurisdiction-aware and validity-aware. No postcode or lookup establishes a public resident, occupant, owner, legal unit, entrance, exact building relation or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.gnaf_rule: GNAF is treated as an operational Iran Post standard-address and geocoding evidence source, not as an open bulk dataset. A pinned response may support an address or coordinate relation only within exact service terms, privacy rules, retention limits and display rights. It cannot be republished as a public address/building corpus without written authority and resource-specific provenance.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires an explicit rights-cleared civic-address identifier, a stable reviewed relation to a building identifier, and separately permitted building or parcel geometry with purpose, authority, jurisdiction, validity, privacy, CRS and digests pinned. Postcode, forwarding prefix, GNAF search, certificate, NSDI layer, administrative polygon, coordinate, road, parcel candidate, OSM footprint or proximity is not an automatic address-building relation.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Postal identifiers, permitted address points, official or derived surfaces and buildings may link to AGID cells through explicit versioned crosswalks without relabelling a postcode, address, building, parcel, administrative area or territory as an AGID cell, or claiming AGID geometry is Iran Post geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The public Iran Post, GNAF, certificate and UPU pages do not grant bulk assignment, address, geometry or redistribution rights. Iran NSDI requires exact layer, publisher, access class and terms. Iran Open Data is an independent reference, not postal or government authority, and requires exact item licensing. ODbL data remains separate. Pin every exact resource, terms version, override and digest before promotion.
postal_system.privacy_rule: A ten-digit place identifier, GNAF lookup, certificate request, standard address, private coordinate, entrance, unit, P.O. Box, resident, recipient, owner, occupant, account and query log may expose household or personal context. They are excluded from public artifacts unless lawful authority, purpose limitation, minimisation, retention and publication approval are explicit.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Postcode assignments, standard addresses, coordinates, administrative context, buildings and crosswalks are time-dependent. Store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, source version and supersession independently; a current lookup must not rewrite historical evidence.
postal_system.territorial_rule: Country code IR selects a runtime and source contract; it is not a sovereignty, jurisdiction, administrative-boundary or universal-coverage assertion. Province, local and other source authority, jurisdiction, language, validity and licence must be explicit. No postal, NSDI, third-party or community source is presumed to cover every area or settle boundary status.
